dose_selection_rule: Q2 exact dose with maximum unique pert_id coverage; tie-break lexical dose string
quality_filter: MCF7,trt_cp,24 h, distil_cc_q75 >= threshold; -666 treated missing
drug_condition_aggregation: median WTCS; retain mean, SD, MAD, n_signatures

stability_grade_rules.high: n_signatures>=3 at primary dose; >=3 doses; negative dose fraction>=0.75; no sign flip; QC median range<0.15; rank_A<=50
stability_grade_rules.medium: n_signatures>=2; >=2 doses; negative dose fraction>=0.5; rank_A<=100
stability_grade_rules.low: one signature or fewer than two doses
